items: 【Experience a 1000% Brighter Night】Transform your drive with our advanced H11 Driving, Fog & Spot Lights. Each H11 light bulbs combo, equipped with 12 high-performance chips, delivers a blinding 45,000 lumens per set. Powered by latest upgraded Z10 technology which provide unparalleled road illumination—turning night into day for a safer, more confident, and utterly superior driving journey.

【Unrivaled Power and Performance】Our H11 light bulbs combo feature an unparalleled cooling system. Crafted with precision from premium aviation-grade aluminum, complemented by a thermostatic copper plate and a high-speed 20,000RPM cooling fan. This ensures swift heat dissipation, maintaining stable and uninterrupted operation. With an extended average lifespan of 70,000 hours per Driving, Fog & Spot Lights, you can count on reliable performance mile after mile.

items.value: 1 Beam Precision】Our H11 light bulbs meticulously replicate the factory halogen bulbs, undergoing numerous adjustments and calibrations to achieve the most flawless light pattern and enhanced visibility. Say goodbye to dark spots or shadowy areas, and rest assured there's no blinding glare for oncoming drivers, ensuring heightened safety on the road.

items: 【Compact Size, Effortless Installation】Setting a new standard in light bulb design, ours are optimized for appearance and functionality. They eliminate the need for external driver boxes and wires, boasting a size 20% smaller than typical all-in-one lights—nearly mirroring the compactness of halogen bulbs in a 1:1 ratio. This streamlined design seamlessly resolves common installation challenges, including compatibility with dust cover.

【98%+ Vehicle Compatibility】Introducing our advanced CBNBUS driver, meticulously engineered to offer enhanced compatibility, especially for sensitive vehicle models. This new generation system ensures seamless integration with a wider range of vehicles. Bid farewell to flickering lights and dashboard warnings, as our H11 light bulbs deliver a flawless performance every time.
【DOT-Approved to FMVSS 108】DOT-approved to FMVSS 108 (49 CFR § 571.108) for enhanced visibility in rain and fog. Test Report No: SiCT2509170943S.
